hypothesis.rationale: Direction #1 (training hyperparameters) exhausted across all categories in Iter 1-14. Direction #2 (model hyperparameters) partially explored - n_mem_tokens improved EM to 0.4634 in Iter 20, but current architecture conflates read/write operations causing memory interference at N=8 scale. Previous architecture attempts (residual connections, positional embeddings) failed to address this fundamental bottleneck.
hypothesis.instruction: In modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py, modify the memory_cross_attention layer to use separate linear projections for read_keys and write_keys. Create two distinct nn.Linear layers: one for generating query keys to read from memory, and another for generating update keys to write to memory. Initialize write_keys with smaller weight scale (0.01) to prevent memory overwriting during early training.
